# Md Ashikur Rahman (Ashik Ayon)

> Personal site of Md Ashikur Rahman, known as Ashik or Ayon, from Rajshahi, Bangladesh. Co-founder and Head of Product at RareDev (SafeShare, Eflow) and co-founder and Director of Strategy at the Sustainability & Life Sciences Network (SLSN).

Md Ashikur Rahman (also written Ashikur Rahman, Md. Ashikur Rahman, Ashik, Ayon; in Bangla আশিক / আশিকুর রহমান) is a product builder from Rajshahi, Bangladesh.

## Work
- RareDev: co-founder and Head of Product since January 2026. RareDev builds SafeShare (https://safeshare.co), privacy-first file sharing used by more than 20,000 people, and Eflow (https://eflow.safeshare.co), a living island for Windows.
- SLSN, Sustainability & Life Sciences Network (https://slsn.community): co-founder and Director of Strategy since August 2025. Organises BOCE (Bangladesh Olympiad on Climate Change & Environmental Issues) with Zero Competitions, brings BIDE to Bangladesh (Ashik leads its graphics team), and is building Quitora, software to help prevent dengue.
- Bangladesh Olympiad on Astronomy & Astrophysics (BDOAA): Senior Associate since December 2024; joined as a graphics intern.
- Uddhar (flood rescue and relief): Admin since August 2024.
- Past: President, Harimohan Govt. High School Debate Club (2025–2026); Assistant General Secretary, Chapainawabganj Debating Club (2025–2026); Head of the Creative Department, Bangladesh United Astronomical Forum (2025–2026); Executive, Creative Department, Bangladesh Space Research Society (2025).

## Honours
- Outstanding Presentation Award, international climate conference / olympiad, Sirius, Russia (2025)
- Champion, 9th Rajshahi College Science Fest (2026)
- First runner-up, IUT Techathon (2026)
- First runner-up, BDOAA Astro Poster Competition (2025)
- Selected, The Knowledge Society (2026)
- Essay accepted, Open Dialogue Russia (2026)

## Travel
- Darjeeling, India (February 2024): Indo-Bangladesh Scouts Friendship Camp, first time representing Bangladesh abroad
- Sirius, Russia (September 2025): International Scientific Conference on Ecology and Climate Change
- Dubai, UAE (September 2025)
- Da Nang and Hoi An, Vietnam (July 2026): Doing Good, a UWC short course
- Malaysia (July 2026)
